candidate_system.name: FORGE: Failure-Optimized Reflective Graduation and Evolution
candidate_system.tested_scope: CybORG CAGE-2 B_line, 30-step horizon; four LLM families; three memory representations

controller_actions.mechanism: continue failure-triggered Reflexion attempts/stages with current persistent memory
on a failure trigger, abort the episode, synthesize/apply a memory update from the failed trajectory, then restart from step 0 with the updated memory
run N=10 parallel instances with independent within-stage experience
after a frozen stage checkpoint, copy the active champion's complete memory to every other active instance for the next stage
graduate instances whose frozen checkpoint return exceeds theta=-15; freeze their memory and exclude them from later stages

broadcast.paper_claimed_matching: same model, memory representation and training budget; only cross-instance champion broadcast is removed
broadcast.result: FORGE improves post-session evaluation by 29-72% over Reflexion in all 12 model-representation conditions
broadcast.interpretation_scope: supports population transfer/broadcast under this benchmark; does not isolate every implementation detail

stop_freeze.result: no-graduation keeps all 10 instances active for all 6 stages, consumes roughly twice the adaptation tokens per active instance by S6, and can outperform full FORGE for Grok/Qwen by up to 67%; Gemini/Llama favor graduation in 2 of 3 representations
stop_freeze.interpretation_scope: graduation primarily saves compute but can terminate learning prematurely; this directly exposes false-stop cost, but is not an equal-total-compute comparison

restart.comparison: no matched cold-restart vs restart-with-artifact ablation found

outer_evaluation.paper_protocol: Checkpoint probes are used during training for champion selection/graduation; Post-Session Evaluation is a separate frozen measurement after the session, with learning disabled.
outer_evaluation.scope_note: separate stochastic evaluation episodes on the same CAGE-2 B_line environment are stronger than reporting checkpoint scores but are not an untouched external benchmark split

public_code_audit.stage_checkpoint_path: run_cyborg_coordinator.py ends each continual-learning session with a new-agent final evaluation episode under is_learning_mode=False; run_experiment.py selects/broadcasts using Final Evaluation Reward parsed from the learning-session logs.
public_code_audit.post_session_eval_path: run_experiment.py creates final_evaluation workspaces, disables continual_learning, and runs the frozen definitions for num_evaluation_runs.
public_code_audit.resume_reconciliation_defect: run_experiment.py resume path initializes graduated_instances={} and explicitly says prior graduation is not persisted/rechecked. Resumed stages therefore treat previously graduated instances as active, and final evaluation cannot recover their frozen graduation memories from earlier stages.
public_code_audit.risk: a crash/restart can violate the intended Stop/Freeze semantics by reactivating and overwriting solutions that the uninterrupted controller would have frozen

evidence_scope.positive: FORGE is the first candidate in this continuation that places at least five relevant controller actions in one persistent self-improvement system and provides same-system ablations for broadcast and graduation plus a separate frozen post-session evaluation.
not_shown: equal-total-budget Stop vs Continue vs Restart-with-artifact comparison
cold restart vs artifact-carrying restart ablation
restart-durable preservation of controller state in current public resume code
physically isolated untouched outer benchmark split

exact_next_action: Search for a persistent self-improving agent that directly compares Stop/Continue/Restart or Widen/Reopen under matched total proposal/evaluation budget and a selection-unused outer test. Prefer systems with explicit crash-resume tests proving preservation of frozen/retired controller state. Separately audit candidate-local anytime-valid promotion, cross-proposal durable statistical spending, immutable artifact identity, feedback bandwidth and complete proposal chronology.
